name: Ollama Cloud Usage Bar Widget
author: bresleveloper
description: Ollama Cloud session and weekly limits with reset times and per-model request counts, from ollama.com's usage API.

barWidget.description: Session and weekly limit meters plus requests by model for each window.

schema.label: Show usage % in the bar
schema.description: When On, the bar shows the fullest window's percentage next to the icon.

schema.label: Show reset times
schema.description: Reads reset times from ollama.com/settings with a headless Chromium and your browser's ollama.com cookie, about every 2 hours. Best-effort: skipped quietly if it fails.
